_comment: Pinned exceptions for scripts/validation/dead-components.mjs (task #365). Every entry is a component file that is UNREACHABLE from client/index.html and server/ — pre-existing dead code found when the gate was introduced. This list is MECHANICALLY shrink-only: the gate carries a frozen manifest of exactly these paths and fails on any entry outside it, so adding or substituting entries here does nothing but fail the gate (allowlist-growth). The only allowed edit is REMOVING an entry together with deleting its dead file; stale pins (file reachable again, or deleted with the entry left behind) also fail. All 22 original pins were resolved by the deletion sweep (task #369).
